description: This file defines a base class 'AuditAware' used for auditing purposes in JPA entities, including fields for creation and modification timestamps and user identifiers, as well as versioning for optimistic locking.

classes.name: AuditAware
classes.description: A superclass providing auditing fields for tracking creation and modification details, with support for JPA auditing annotations and Lombok-generated getters and setters.

methods.name: getCreatedDate
methods.description: Getter for createdDate, returns the Instant when the entity was created.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Getter for createdBy, returns the identifier of the creator.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Getter for modifiedDate, returns the Instant when the entity was last modified.

methods.name: getModifiedBy
methods.description: Getter for modifiedBy, returns the identifier of the last modifier.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Getter for version, returns the version number for optimistic locking.
